provider_states.title: OpenAQ
notes: OPENAQ_API_KEY is required by the current OpenAQ v3 runtime path.

provider_states.title: EIA API
notes: EIA_API_KEY is required to activate EIA in runtime.

provider_states.title: ACLED
notes: ACLED_API_KEY is optional in Batch 3 and only used for geopolitics depth when configured.

provider_states.title: Private Listing Feed
notes: PRIVATE_LISTING_FEED_TOKEN or PRIVATE_LISTING_FEED_URL can be added later for housing and personal-finance depth.

provider_states.title: TheSportsDB
notes: Using TheSportsDB as the live sports backbone for fixture grounding, recent form, and table context.

provider_states.title: API-Football
notes: API-Football is configured as optional sports context only (history, odds, standings) and never drives live fixture unlock.
